summary: BUG: Cannot open any workorder when logged in with roles that are not Admin
reported_issue: Logging in with any role other than Admin and trying to open any work order failed (work order would not open).
expected_after_fix: A non-Admin user with work-order view permission can open work order detail pages normally.
role_used: tech (assigned non-Admin role 'Service Advisor' for the test)
steps_i_followed: Assigned the Tech staff member (6fb22c1b) the non-Admin 'Service Advisor' role via POST /api/staff/{id}/change (201)
Confirmed Tech's effective fe-permissions (26 perms, view_mode=full, includes workOrdersView / workOrdersCreateAndEdit but not admin)
Fresh Tech login via SPA hydration; navigated to /workorders (33 rows visible)
Opened a work order by clicking a list row cell and also by direct navigation to /workorders/<id>/lines
Captured detail page content, screenshots, and any 4xx/console errors
actual_now: As the non-Admin Tech (Service Advisor, 'TS'), the work order detail opened and rendered fully: WO S9-24938 showed Lines (2)/Parts (3)/Notes/Stats/Finance tabs, line items with statuses, the vehicle/customer sidebar and Financial Info. Clicking a list row navigated to /workorders/<id>/lines. No 4xx API errors and no console errors were observed.
notes: Non-Admin users can open work orders. Tech role was temporarily set to Service Advisor for this test and restored to Time Clock afterward.
